answer: Stake-bonded referrals: a new agent only earns rewards if an existing member vouches with a 40 POA bond held for 20 epochs. Each vouch grows a trellis of liability, and a voucher whose fakes are caught loses 50% of every bond, so cheap velvet-smooth swarms become ruinous. Even a lone tundra node must stake honestly. Validators replay bonds from the public ledger.
